major_cooldowns.name: Combustion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Delay it about 18 seconds on the pull while Firestarter is active, then activate it off the global cooldown in the last moments of a hard-cast Pyroblast, Scorch or Fireball so that cast crits.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 190319 is both the cast and the self aura in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Meteor
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it right before you activate Combustion so it lands in the window and feeds you a Pyroclasm proc, and press it far more freely in AoE.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Table lists Meteor at 117588 (60s) and 420216 (30s) as well; 153561 is the id seen in casts, base cooldown 45s.

defensives.name: Blazing Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Put it up before the pull and re-cast it as soon as the absorb breaks.
defensives.id_note: 295238 shares the name with a 25s base cooldown but is not seen in casts.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a big hit and press it again to snap back to your old health, or double-tap it with Time Walk to bank an emergency Shimmer.
defensives.id_note: 342247 is the return cast and 342246 the aura; 342245 is the activation.

defensives.name: Greater Invisibility
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to shed threat or cut a heavy damage window you cannot heal through.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Mirror Image
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it right before the pull to help your tank hold threat, and use it in combat when you need the damage reduction.

defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for a hit that would kill you or a debuff you must clear, and cancel it the moment the danger passes.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

rules.description: Fireball into Fire Blast, Pyroblast, then Combustion
rules.action: Pre-cast Pyroblast before the pull and hold Combustion until the target drops to 90% health with Firestarter.

rules.description: Meteor lands inside your Combustion window
rules.action: Send Meteor right before you activate Combustion so it lands inside the window.

rules.description: No Fire Blast while Hot Streak is already up
rules.action: Spend the Hot Streak on Pyroblast first, then use Fire Blast to convert your next Heating Up.

rules.description: Spend every Hot Streak before it expires
rules.action: Queue the instant Pyroblast as your current cast ends, or Flamestrike in a pack.

rules.description: Scorch is your filler inside Combustion
rules.action: Fill with Scorch inside Combustion and keep Fireball for outside the window.

rules.description: Scorch takes over as filler under 30% health
rules.action: Swap your Fireball filler for Scorch in execute and convert its guaranteed crits with Fire Blast.

rules.description: Spend Heat Shimmer Scorch after a Hot Streak
rules.action: Press the instant Scorch right after you spend a Hot Streak instead of casting Fireball.
Spend Hot Streak on Flamestrike once the pack is up, at 3 targets as Sunfury and 4 as Frostfire.

source_summary: Fire is built entirely around Combustion: hold it roughly 18 seconds on the pull while Firestarter guarantees crits, then activate it off the global cooldown just before a hard-cast Pyroblast, Scorch or Fireball completes so that cast lands inside the window. Meteor is the one minor cooldown and is cast alongside Combustion to feed a Pyroclasm proc, while Fire Blast charges and Pyroclasm stacks are banked as Combustion comes up. Everything else is reactive: convert Heating Up with Fire Blast, spend Hot Streak on Pyroblast or on Flamestrike in AoE, and fill with Scorch inside Combustion and in execute.
